It is impossible to leave this card until the test has been completed. Character special abilities may allow them to escape locked tests.

If this symbol is present and the party has the required colored unlock token. The pictured party member must go to this card when entering this location. The card should be revealed to all party members.
Equipment:
Blessings can be used by the holding agent on any agent on the same card during any challenge. Spending a blessing allows one to re-roll one challenge die.
Healing poultices can be used at any time by the holding agent on any agent on the same card. Each token recovers one lost health {I:heart:40:-2}.
A soul, the incorporeal essence of a living being. These are very powerful and very scarce resources. How they might be used...
Ammunition for a weapon of some sort. Every time the weapon is used, one of these tokens must be spent.

A happy but reserved Bob is waiting for you as you exit the caissons. Things seem fine, but was Bob wearing that "bishop" garb when we left? And where did that inquisition logo come from? {s:card_b_default_italic}"Welcome back, the rift has been successfully closed, Keith has been stopped and time once again flows undisturbed. To tell the truth, I struggled with the decision to send you. To have to deal with a great man like Keith, I sort of felt like Pilate. But I knew I could count on you to put things right! I'm sure we will have more tasks for you, but first let's get you out of those old outfits and into something more appropriate. "{s:} He gestures to fresh uniforms in the corner, topped with glowing soul medallions...{n}{n}Congratulations for a job well done! ... ?

You are greeted by Bob's smiling face as you exit the caissons. News of your skillful handling of a tricky situation must have preceded you. {s:card_b_default_italic}"Congratulations, the rift is closed and Keith’s plans have been thwarted. I do hope his impact on the timelines has been minimized. Please continue into the next room and Laura will debrief you. I am so pleased with your performance this time around, that I have a special treat for you in mind... What do you think of a paid vacation in some exotic place in time? I will bring it up with management! In the meantime, Laura is waiting in the next room..."{s:}{n}{n}Congratulations for a job well done!

Bob is there as you climb out of the caissons. He is not smiling. {s:card_b_default_italic}"I expect the best from my agents and you are making me reconsider my recommendations"{s:}, he laments. {s:card_b_default_italic}"We still have a chance to stop Keith, but the window is narrowing. Get back in there and track him down, quickly!"{s:} You respond by turning around and getttomg back into the caissons. The all too familiar countdown begins...

Leave in place all items marked {I:blue_logo:75:-2} but reset the rest of the game. Return the other item cards to the deck. Reread cards E and F of the {s:card_b_action_bold}Base{s:} location and follow the instructions. Two more things:{n}• Take token {I:token_black_1:75:-2}.{n}• You may start from any location listed on the visible plan cards.

Laura greets you in a sullen voice, {s:card_b_default_italic}"Bob has been acting strangely in your absence. I think he is considering sending a new team. I fear you may be our last hope."{s:} Bob stamps into the room, anger obvious in his face, but was that a soul medallion tucked under his shirt? {s:card_b_default_italic}"There is no time to talk, you have to get back to it and immediately! Let's get it done this time and close that rift."{s:} You avoid his gaze and climb back into the caissons as Laura counts down...

Leave in place all items marked {I:blue_logo:75:-2} but reset the rest of the game. Return the other item cards to the deck. Reread cards E and F of the {s:card_b_action_bold}Base{s:} location and follow the instructions. Three more things:{n}• Take token {I:token_black_1:75:-2}.{n}• You may start from any location listed on the visible plan cards.{n}• Increase the starting {I:time:40:-2} to 50.
Path to Town
Location: {ls}
A-B-C-D-E-F

A well-traveled road winds between a low hill on the right and an open field on the left. As your party rounds the bend, a small town becomes visible in the distance, punctuated by the gilded cross capping the chapel in the center of town.{n}Your group catches up with some other travelers headed into town. The captive woman in a donkey drawn cage catches your attention.

The peasant pulls you out of earshot of the cart party. {s:card_b_default_italic}"My name is Diego Rodríguez and I need your help. My sister Catalina was working in the local tavern when the Inquisition came into town. After a few minutes of questioning they took her in a cart like this one to the town up ahead and we have not heard from her in a week. In fact I think she wanted to go with them! I have heard stories about what they do with these girls and I fear for her life. Here is a picture of Catalina. If you find any information about her, please let me know. I plan to visit the tavern in town. Drink makes for loose lips they say."{s:}
• Take {s:card_b_action_bold}Item {in:Catalina's Picture}{s:}

A young woman wearing a silver cross necklace is locked in the cage. When you look into her eyes she seems... distant... not fully aware of your presence. You ask her name and she responds in slow, slurred speech, {s:card_b_default_italic}"I seem to be called ... 'Juana'"{s:}. When quizzed about her predicament, she only gestures to the tall man and smiles.

The acolyte warns you not to speak with the prisoner. {s:card_b_default_italic}"One cannot trust those in league with the unnamed one. They have ways of turning your mind and clouding your judgement. But we will take care of them, we will save them... all!"{s:}. He begins singing a hymn and ignores you further.

• If you have {s:card_b_action_bold}Item {in:Stick}{s:} you may try to steal his sword, replacing it with the item.{n} • Steal the sword: {I:skill_agile:75:-2} 4x{I:shield:75:-2}{n} On success take {s:card_b_action_bold}Item {in:Sword}{s:}, lose {s:card_b_action_bold}Item {in:Stick}{s:}.

The tall man hears you approach and addresses you without turning around. {s:card_b_default_italic}"You are coming to this village in dark times, my friend. The forces of evil seem to be particularly strong in this area. But do not worry: His Holiness the Pope prays for us every day, and is sending here his most trusted men to bring these poor lost souls back onto the path of righteousness, saving them from eternal damnation. Women are particularly weak and attract the forces of evil, so we must help them the most. We have to stay strong and have faith: the fight will be long and fierce, but the forces of Heaven will prevail. Mala tempora currunt, sed peiora parantur."
You step into a stand of small saplings and break off a short wooden stick.
• Take {s:card_b_action_bold}Item {in:Stick}{s:}
Graveyard

Dim shafts of light flicker though the clouds, illuminating the town cemetery and producing eerie shadows. New graves are being dug and the earth is freshly mounded in multiple locations. A cluster of people sobbing disturbs the quiet. So many stories mark their closing chapters here. This does not feel like a place of peace...
{s:card_b_default_italic}"Martin, a soul displaced in time. May he find his peace in death."
• If you have {s:card_b_action_bold}Item {in:Shovel}{s:} you sift through the soil and make a most curious discovery. Take {s:card_b_action_bold}Item {in:Right Arm}{s:}.
A simple cross marks a tiny, child's grave. {s:card_b_default_italic}"Here lies our beloved son, called to our Father long before his time"{s:}
• If Sister María visits the grave, she takes {s:card_b_action_bold}Item {in:trigger_nun}{s:}.

A group of women has their backs turned to you. They are looking at a fresh grave. You get close enough to the group to hear their cries between sobs {s:card_b_default_italic}"... why ... how! she never did ... witch ... impossible! ... and the fire... her poor soul ... into ...sphere. ...pray for her..."{s:}. You leave without interrupting their mourning.

The tombstone reads {s:card_b_default_italic}"Here lies Maria Felicia: mother, wife, purified witch. May the Heavens forgive her".{s:} There seems to be a glass shard embedded as decoration in the face of the tombstone.
• If you choose to examine the decoration further, take {s:card_b_action_bold}Item {in:Stained Glass B}{s:}.

A man sits on a stone, resting from digging, a shovel at his feet. {s:card_b_default_italic}"Hello visitors, I am Gonzalo the groundkeeper. Looking for a grave in particular? Please excuse the current conditions of the cemetery, we have been busier than usual lately. Indeed my siesta is over, I need to continue digging new graves. Please let me know if you need anything."{s:}

• You may try to obtain his shovel. This can be done by either:{n}• Talking him out of it:{I:skill_glib:75:-2} 2x{I:shield_time:75:-2} 2x{I:shield:75:-2}{n}• Stealing it from him:{I:skill_agile:75:-2} 2x{I:shield_time:75:-2} 2x{I:shield:75:-2}{n} On success take {s:card_b_action_bold}Item {in:Shovel}{s:}.
Tavern
A-B-C-D-E-F-G

You enter the smoke-filled room. On your left is the barkeep, looking to serve you. To the right are a scattered collection of semi-occupied tables. On your far right a mysterious man, dressed completely in black sits alone. He makes eye contact with you...
The common bar is here with a barkeep keeping watch over those entering his establishment. {s:card_b_default_italic}"Welcome weary travelers! What brings you into our arms today?"{s:}
• If Gaspar visits the bar, he takes {s:card_b_action_bold}Item {in:Bottle of Alcohol}{s:}.

Three men seated around a table make eye contact and shake their heads. The visibly drunk men appear to be in a fighting mood. The nearest one sneers and spits out an angry {s:card_b_default_italic}"What did you say about my mother?"{s:}
• {I:lock:75:-2} A fight ensues:{n} • They attack: {I:skill_combat:75:-2} 1x{I:shield_heart:75:-2} 3x{I:shield_red_skull:75:-2}{n} On success ... you walk away from three downed fools.

You take a seat at an empty table in the back of the tavern and begin to drink off the day's struggles. Two acolytes trundle into the tavern, going from table to table, interrupting conversations with troubling, pointed questions. They approach your table. {s:card_b_default_italic}"Strangers, this is a holy town, take care to mind your vices here. You look like trouble to us and we have ways of dealing with trouble!"{s:}

• {I:lock:75:-2} Two ways to resolve this situation:{n} • Placate them: 2x{I:time:75:-2}{n}And leave in peace, or{n} • Confront them: {I:skill_combat:75:-2} 1x{I:shield_heart:75:-2} 2x{I:shield_red_skull:75:-2} 1x{I:shield:75:-2}{n}On success take {s:card_b_action_bold}Item {in:Star Chart C}{s:}.
A slightly intoxicated man sits at a table alone with a large pouch. When you come close, he looks at you with a puzzled look on his face while grasping on his bottle.
• If Bishop Aguilar is on this card he takes {s:card_b_action_bold}Item {in:Space-Time Book}{s:}.

You take a seat across from a hooded, quiet man with strange tattoos on his face. He does not seem to want to talk, but does not seem to mind you sitting with him. Who might be able to coerce him into divulging his secrets?

• If Isabel is on this card the man might be convinced to speak. Only Isabel can do the challenge, alone:{n} • {I:skill_glib:75:-2} 4x{I:shield:75:-2}{n}On success, Isabel takes {s:card_b_action_bold}Item {in:trigger_streets}{s:}.

The chapel housemaid makes eye contact and discretely gestures for you to join her. {s:card_b_default_italic}"I must warn you: be wary of the clergy in this town. They say beautiful things about freeing women from their dark sides, but are quick to summary judgment and punishment. I would not be so sure about their intentions either. They have exotic objects that they hide from everyone's sight. God forgive me, I suspect they use black magic themselves. I stole this from their study. It seemed very important, perhaps you can investigate this matter further?"{s:}
• She hands you {s:card_b_action_bold}Item {in:Stained Glass A}{s:}.
Chapel

You enter an austere stone building. The interior shares the same aged look as the exterior. Scarred stone walls enclose the space. At the entrance is a confessional booth, door open, inviting confessors. In the center is a small altar with unfinished wooden benches in front. Behind a partition, book stacks are visible and a most curious door.
You enter the confessional, a claustrophobic box with a small grille on one of the walls. You close the door behind you and face the grille.

• You may confess: {s:card_b_default_italic} "Bless me, Father, for I have sinned..."{s:} or leave the confessional.{n}• If Doña Ortiz confesses, she takes item {s:card_b_action_bold}Item {in:trigger_lady}{s:}{n}• If Sister María confesses, she may refill her blessings tokens {I:blessing:75:-2} to 2.{n}• If other characters confess, their sins are forgiven.

A housemaid is cleaning altar fixtures and looks nervously toward your group {s:card_b_default_italic}"You are not from here are you?"{s:} she asks in a hushed voice. You mention that you have followed the cart into town and ask if that is a common sight here. {s:card_b_default_italic}"You must be very careful around the clergy here..."{s:}, the maid remarks.
• You may engage the young woman in conversation:{n} • {I:skill_glib:75:-2} 4x{I:shield:75:-2}{n}On success, take {s:card_b_action_bold}Item {in:housemaid_talk}{s:}.

A few stacks of books sit on a table with a sparsely populated bookcase in the background. This "library" has most obviously been heavily used and is very rare for a small village chapel. Some of the books are in English and do not appear to be hand-written. Many of the books are of non-ecclesiastical content. They include works on astronomy by Ibn Zarqala and surgery by Albucasis mixed with works on alchemy and celestial formations.
• You leaf through the book open on the desk. Take {s:card_b_action_bold}Item {in:Astronomy Book}{s:}.
Torch lit steps lead downward into the earth. A malodorous breath of dank air rises up from the depths, chilling to the bone.
• Take {s:card_b_action_bold}Item {in:Plan Add Catacombs}{s:}.
Courthouse
A-B-C-D-E-F-G-H

The courtroom is spread out in front of your party. On the left is the gallery from which a collection of townsfolk observe the proceedings. A decorative piece of glass gracing the end of an occupied bench catches your eye. In the center, the counsel and the bailiff stand at a table before the judge with a despondent, haggered looking defendant. The judge has just rendered a verdict and is recording his decision...

The gallery consists of occupied, decorative wooden benches. There is an odd-looking piece of stained glass attached to the end of a bench, "guarded" by a stern looking woman. If you want the glass...

• There are two ways to obtain the stained glass.{n} • Pilfer it: {I:skill_agile:75:-2} 4x{I:shield:75:-2}, or{n} • Convince the woman you need to remove it for "cleaning": {I:skill_glib:75:-2} 4x{I:shield:75:-2}.{n}On success, take {s:card_b_action_bold}Item {in:Stained Glass D}{s:}.

A female defendent sits with her counsel in front of the judge. The defendant quietly sobs, {s:card_b_default_italic}"But they took my sister... I’m telling the truth! They drugged her and took her from us!"{s:} The prosecutor whispers, {s:card_b_default_italic}"be quiet child! You must have been dreaming. Tell them you were just confused... for your own sake!"{s:}

• The defendant turns to you and hands you a little package, {s:card_b_default_italic}"They dropped this piece of witchcraft when they took her. Please, find my sister!"{s:} Take {s:card_b_action_bold}Item {in:Plunger Tube}{s:}.

A menacing bailiff stands, arms crossed, behind a podium rising like a tombstone between you and the bailiff. {s:card_b_default_italic}"Stand back"{s:} warns the bailiff as you approach the podium {s:card_b_default_italic}"Unless you want to become a defendant!"{s:} An appropriate epitah for folk who fail to heed his warning? A scroll on the podium catches your eye.

• If you try to take the scroll the bailiff will confront you: {s:card_b_default_italic}"Miscreant!"{s:}{n} • {I:skill_combat:75:-2} 2x{I:shield_heart:75:-2} 2x{I:shield_red_skull:75:-2} 2x{I:shield:75:-2} {n} On success, take the scroll, {s:card_b_action_bold}Item {in:Star Chart D}{s:}, and what the bailiff was reaching for, {s:card_b_action_bold}Item {in:Tube with Handle}{s:}.

A Saint Inquisitor is sitting on a high chair behind a desk full of books and sheets of papers. As you approach the judge's bench: {s:card_b_default_italic}"I find the defendant guilty. We will not tolerate the spread of seditious lies about the Inquisition."{s:} growls the magistrate. {s:card_b_default_italic}"Perhaps a session with the interrogators will help you see the error of your ways. Yes, that should prove very effective. Veritas fidelis defendit!"{s:} The defendant covers her face in horror. The judge is busy writing on a piece of paper and pays little attention to you as you approach.
• You may try to steal his notes{n} • {I:skill_agile:75:-2} 4x{I:shield:75:-2}{n} On success, take {s:card_b_action_bold}Item {in:Plan Add Field}{s:}.

The judge turns slowly to the Sister and utters the bone chilling words: {s:card_b_default_italic}"Witch, how dare you defile my courtroom with your presence! Your actions were of the highest intended good, but the dark ways are never the solution. I find you guilty and sentence you to a session with the interrogators. May God have mercy."{s:}

• The Sister cannot leave this card and when the group chooses to leave the {s:card_b_action_bold}{ls:Courthouse}{s:} location, they must next go to the {s:card_b_action_bold}{ls:Dungeon}{s:} location. Take {s:card_b_action_bold}Item {in:Plan Add Dungeon}{s:} and the Sister takes the token {I:token_yellow_3:100:-2}.

The judge turns slowly to the Doña Ortiz and utters the bone chilling words: {s:card_b_default_italic}"Witch, how dare you defile my courtroom with your presence! Your ill-begotten status will not save you this time. Look around you, there are no nobles here to help you today! I find you guilty and sentence you to a session with the interrogators."{s:}

• The Doña cannot leave this card and when the group chooses to leave the {s:card_b_action_bold}{ls:Courthouse}{s:} location, they must next go to the {s:card_b_action_bold}{ls:Dungeon}{s:} location. Take {s:card_b_action_bold}Item {in:Plan Add Dungeon}{s:} and the Doña takes the token {I:token_pink_4:100:-2}.

The judge turns slowly to Isabel and utters the bone chilling words: {s:card_b_default_italic}"Witch, how dare you defile my courtroom with your presence! You've tricked and beguiled your way out of many such situations in the past, but not this one. I will spare these God-fearing folks from your temptations. I find you guilty and sentence you to a session with the interrogators."{s:}

• Isabel cannot leave this card and when the group chooses to leave the {s:card_b_action_bold}{ls:Courthouse}{s:} location, they must next go to the {s:card_b_action_bold}{ls:Dungeon}{s:} location. Take {s:card_b_action_bold}Item {in:Plan Add Dungeon}{s:} and Isabel takes the token {I:token_black_2:100:-2}.
Dungeon

A large stone dark room opens before your eyes. Its smell makes you think of death and feel of despair. Shouts of pain are mixed with prayers and the sound of tendons stretched to their limits. On your left, a man completely dressed in black is blocking your way. Next to him, a storage cabinet stands, half open. In the middle of the room, a number of people are about to 'confess'. At the far right, a group of women is smiling and waving at you.

{s:card_b_default_italic}"We do not usually allow visitors in the inquisitor chambers, but you seem a tight group. Maybe your presence can help these women confess faster. Do not touch anything! There are plenty of objects filled with dark magic in this room. With the help of God, this will all be over soon."{s:}
A cupboard with glass windows. The cupboard is locked, but an odd box and a scroll are visible through the glass.
• To open the cupboard, you must complete the challenge:{n} • {I:skill_agile:75:-2} 3x{I:shield:75:-2}{n} On success, take {s:card_b_action_bold}Item {in:Box of Lightning}{s:}.

Sister María is bound to a chair in front of a table of questionable instruments. She breaks down completely, unable to hide her secret any longer. {s:card_b_default_italic}"I had no choice don't you see? God did not answer my prayers and I could not let the child die. What else could I have done? I have committed grave sins for which there can be no atonement. Do with me what you will, my soul is in your hands."{s:} A lone crow lands on an overhead beam as she admits to having embraced the dark arts. A tear rolls down the face of the man in front of her as he slowly makes the sign of the cross.

• Sister María cannot leave this card and when the group chooses to leave the {s:card_b_action_bold}{ls:Dungeon}{s:} location, they must next go to the {s:card_b_action_bold}{ls:Field}{s:} location. Take {s:card_b_action_bold}Item {in:Plan Add Field}{s:} and the Sister takes the token {I:token_grey_4:100:-2}.

Doña Ortiz lies on a metal bed with hands and feet bound. A brazier in the corner has long handled iron brands sticking out of it. Still under the effects of the drugs, the Doña is mesmerized by the flames from the braziers in the corner and for the first time loses her composure and admits to practicing witchcraft. A black cat observes from the safety of a dark corner. A man solemnly nods to the guards in the corner. They approach...

• Doña Ortiz cannot leave this card and when the group chooses to leave the {s:card_b_action_bold}{ls:Dungeon}{s:} location, they must next go to the {s:card_b_action_bold}{ls:Field}{s:} location. Take {s:card_b_action_bold}Item {in:Plan Add Field}{s:} and the Doña takes the token {I:token_pink_3:100:-2}.

Isabel has been lashed to the wheel. A man covered by a black mask asks her one question after the other without waiting for your reply. That voice, the cadence, the drink... Madness! Isabel shrieks with laughter, unable to fight the influences of the evil brew any longer {s:card_b_default_italic}"Yes, yes I am the witch that you seek!"{s:} Silently, a snake coils in the corner. The man laughs out loud, {s:card_b_default_italic}"I was expecting more fight from one like you. No matter, you shall reap now what you have sown."{s:} Guards release her and escort her roughly out of the room.

• Isabel cannot leave this card and when the group chooses to leave the {s:card_b_action_bold}{ls:Dungeon}{s:} location, they must next go to the {s:card_b_action_bold}{ls:Field}{s:} location. Take {s:card_b_action_bold}Item {in:Plan Add Field}{s:} and Isabel takes the token {I:token_blue_3:100:-2}.
The smell becomes particularly strong. You suddenly realize you have stepped on something. You reach down to pick it up, careful not to be seen by the guards.
• Take {s:card_b_action_bold}Item {in:Left Arm}{s:}.

A group of women are looking towards you with creepy smiles on their faces. {s:card_b_default_italic}"What is a beautiful thing like you doing in such a sinful place like this one? Do you not know we are all sinners and slaves of evil one? Fortunately God will soon purify our souls with fire and grant us a new beginning. Help us enjoy the pleasures of the flesh one last time before we are made pure again?"{s:}

• {I:lock:75:-2}Only a guilded tongue can extricate you from this situation!{n} • {I:skill_glib:75:-2} 2x{I:shield_time:75:-2} 2x{I:shield:75:-2} {n} On success take {s:card_b_action_bold}Item {in:Magic Voice Box}{s:}.
Field
A grassy hill on the outskirts of town provides a scenic location for an otherwise gristly ritual. A foul smell permeates the air. Ashes still swirl in the mid-afternoon breeze.

The inquisitor stands in front of a small group of fervent citizens with blood-lust in their eyes. {s:card_b_default_italic}"My children, stay strong in your faith and unfailing love. These women have freely confessed to consorting with minions of evil. Today we show them compassion and love, freeing them to once again accept the true faith. By fire, let them be cleansed! Quia pulvis eris et in pulverem revertis."{s:} The crowd responds enthusiastically {s:card_b_default_italic}"Quia pulvis eris et in pulverem revertis!"{s:}

• An odd bulb hangs at his waist. You may try to take it while he blusters on.{n} • Steal the bulb: {I:skill_agile:75:-2} 3x{I:shield:75:-2}{n} On success take {s:card_b_action_bold}Item {in:Soul Medallion}{s:} and one soul token {I:soul:75:-2}.
What has just happened here? A tell-tale pile of smoldering ashes lies on the ground. You sort through the still warm ashes, the last remnants of a tortured soul.
• Take {s:card_b_action_bold}Item {in:Catalina Locket}{s:} and {s:card_b_action_bold}Item {in:Right Leg}{s:}.

A pile of kindling and construction materials lie off to the side. A lone peasant looks forlornly at the proceedings. You strike up a conversation with the peasant. {s:card_b_default_italic}"So many women, so much death... It is almost like he 'harvests' them. When will it all end?"{s:}

• A flash of light catches your eye in the pile of sticks and grasses. If you choose to investigate you must accept the challenge.{n} • {I:skill_glib:75:-2} 3x{I:shield:75:-2}{n} On success take {s:card_b_action_bold}Item {in:Stained Glass C}{s:}.

An intensely macabre sight, but surprisingly serene. Sister María is tied to a stake as a crow looks onward from a safe distance. A pair of acolytes stand, burning torches in hand. Around their necks are odd, glowing orbs. The pair lash the sister to the stake. One of the acolytes tosses a small metallic sphere into the base of the kindling as the other dispassionately lights the fire... You avert your eyes from the horrific scene, awaiting screams that... never come? She behaves very oddly, no struggling, no screaming and seems to pass quickly, in peace. Interestingly, you notice a flash of blue light coming from within the fire just before she passes into inactivity and the crow makes a familiar call. Your party quietly mourns the loss of an honored comrade. There can be no solace...

• The Sister María character card is removed. Her essence transfers to her familiar, take {s:card_b_action_bold}Item {in:the_crow}{s:} and continue the mission using the new character. Take one soul token {I:soul:75:-2}.

A shocking scene unfolds before you. The Doña Ortiz stands in regal defiance in front of a stake as a black cat appears from behind a rock. A pair of acolytes stand, burning torches in hand. Around their necks are odd, glowing orbs. The pair lash her to the stake. One of the acolytes tosses a small metallic sphere into the base of the kindling as the other dispassionately lights the fire. Your eyes lock with hers, but she seems to lack concern? As the sphere drops into the flames, her body goes limp as the cat lies down in the grass. You notice a flash of blue light coming from within the fire just before she passes into inactivity. You can stand the sight no longer and turn away as a tear dampens your cheek.

A longstanding nun with a questionable reputation.
